_comment: The only hand-written text on the page. Keep every line short; the page is meant to be scanned, not read. Rewrite each quarter together with research-trends.json.

takeaways.title: Agency, not adoption
takeaways.en: The question moved from whether people accept AI to how human and machine agency is configured and held to account.

takeaways.title: Regulation became the research question
takeaways.en: Policy left the limitations paragraph. Editors now want work on which sanctions actually change behaviour.

takeaways.title: GenAI rules are written down, and they conflict
takeaways.en: ISJ bars it from any intellectual work. MS, JIT and ISR allow it under transparency and verification.

takeaways.title: Platform and green-IT framings are cooling
takeaways.en: The metaverse is now defended rather than argued. Narrow Green IT has been folded into responsible technology.

rising.why: an organizational problem, not an interface one
now a site of research, not commentary

fading.why: the artefact has to be described
